a preliminary short-form base shelf prospectus in Canada and a corresponding Form F-10 registration statement with the U.S. SEC.
The filings would allow Cardiol to potentially raise up to US$150M through common shares, debt securities, warrants, subscription receipts, units, or combinations thereof.
No securities are being offered or sold at this time, and the filing does not obligate Cardiol to conduct an offering.
If approved and made effective, the shelf prospectus would remain valid for 25 months.
The potential financing could provide Cardiol with additional flexibility to fund its ongoing development of anti-inflammatory and anti-fibrotic therapies for heart disease.

title: Cardiol Therapeutics files US$150M base shelf prospectus
